JotPsych (behavioral-health AI software) | Chief of Staff | New York, ON-SITE (5 days) | Full-time | $130-160K + significant equity

The person between the founders and everything not getting done. We hand you open-ended problems and you return them solved: cut support hours, build the content engine, fix attribution and change the landing page yourself. Systems thinker, builds their own tools, AI-pilled not AI-sloppy. Our last CoS now runs growth + ops; you move up fast.

Apply (starts with a voicemail, on purpose): https://jotpsych.com/careers-chief-of-staff?utm_source=cos-h...
